title: CSIR NCL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 03 Project Associate II Posts
description: CSIR National Chemical Laboratory (CSIR NCL) has issued the official notification for recruitment 2026. To fill the vacancies for 03 Project Associate II positions. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech, M.Pharm, and M.V.Sc. can use this chance and apply for the CSIR NCL Recruitment 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. If you want more, here is a list of Government Jobs in 2026...
